:::{#def-test-set}
#### Test set

The **test set** of a [training/validation/test split](#def-data-splits)
is the [held-out set](#def-held-out-set) of observations indexed by $\testidx$,
on which the rule of the [validation choice](#def-validation-choice) $\candproc{\est{\icand}}$ is scored:

$$
\paren{(\predvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})}_{\iobs \in \testidx}.
$$ {#eq-test-set}

:::
